summary: First-finish smoke test of NECircle. Backend endpoints validated via curl (auth, admin stats, batch, tag get/claim, phone validation, ZIP export). Frontend validated via Playwright covering landing, admin protection, login (invalid+valid), admin dashboard testids/filters/inventory links, public claim form (Bengali microcopy, shadcn Select business/vehicle toggle showing note-input, name/phone error testids, error clearing on typing), successful claim rendering contact-page same URL with correct tel:/wa.me hrefs, 404 tag-not-found, and logout clearing session.
passed: GET /api/ -> 200 {service:NECircle, ok:true}
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401; correct -> 200 with token/email/role=admin
GET /api/auth/me no token -> 401; with Bearer -> 200
POST /api/admin/tags/batch (count=2) -> {created:2, from:'00009', to:'00010'} (sequential continuation from highest id)
GET /api/admin/stats -> {printed, activated, unassigned} correct and update after batch
GET /api/admin/tags -> sorted list of tags (00001,00002,...)
GET /api/tags/00099999 -> 404 'Tag not found'; GET /api/tags/00001 -> tag payload
POST /api/tags/{id}/claim invalid phone '12345' and '5555555555' -> 422 'Enter a valid Indian phone number'
POST /api/tags/{id}/claim empty name -> 422 string_too_short
POST /api/tags/00003/claim valid vehicle with '+91 98765 43210' -> phone normalized to '9876543210', note nulled
POST /api/tags/00004/claim business with note -> note stored
POST /api/tags/00001/claim already active -> 409 'Tag already activated'
GET /api/admin/tags/qr-zip?scope=unassigned no auth -> 401; with auth -> 200 application/zip, filename 'necircle-qr-unassigned-*.zip', valid zip containing NECircle-{id}.png files
Frontend landing shows NECircle brand + Operator sign in + Open operator dashboard links
/admin unauthenticated redirects to /login
/login invalid creds shows [data-testid=login-error]; valid creds navigate to /admin
Admin dashboard exposes testids: stat-printed, stat-activated, stat-unassigned, batch-count-input, generate-batch-button, download-zip-button, filter-all/unassigned/active, logout-button
Inventory filter counts consistent (all >= unassigned/active); tag cards link to /p/{id}
/p/00099999 renders [data-testid=tag-not-found]
/p/{unassigned_id} renders Bengali microcopy 'এই ট্যাগটি এখনো চালু করা হয়নি।' with claim form
Type select toggling Business shows [data-testid=note-input]; Vehicle hides it
Empty submit shows name-error and phone-error; invalid phone '12345' shows phone-error; retyping valid phone clears it

Successful claim (name='Test User', phone='9876543210', vehicle) re-renders same URL as [data-testid=contact-page] without navigation; call-button href='tel:+919876543210'; whatsapp-button href='https://wa.me/919876543210' target='_blank'
Logout clears session; revisiting /admin redirects to /login
notes: Type-of-tag uses a shadcn Select (button[role=combobox]), not radio labels — tests updated accordingly.
Phone normalization confirmed: '+91 98765 43210' -> '9876543210' stored; contact hrefs use +91 prefix.
ZIP endpoint returned 6 PNGs for unassigned tags with correct NECircle-{id}.png naming.
DB was not pre-empty (previous seed data present) so batch sequential ids were verified as continuation from highest id rather than starting at 00001.
